name: @privacyscrubber/mcp-server
description: CISO-Approved Zero-Trust PII & Secrets Redaction MCP Server for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop. Prevent API leaks and comply with HIPAA/SOC 2 locally.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('../scripts/build-mcp.js')) require('child_process').execSync('node ../scripts/build-mcp.js --keep-obfuscated', {stdio:'inherit'}); else console.log('MCP assets are pre-built.');"
scripts.test: node test-mcp.js && node test-mcp-deep.js && node test-mcp-streaming.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of ['ps-license-manager.js','ps-license-manager.cjs','ps-pii-engine.js','ps-pii-engine.cjs','scrubber-core.cjs']){const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(c.includes('OFFLINE_KEY_SALT')||c.includes('computeV2Signature')||!c.includes('_0x')){console.error('FATAL: Unobfuscated '+f+' detected!'); process.exit(1);}}" && npm test

author: Ilya Sibiryakov (BrandMeWeb)
